title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: Think about why we use cross-validation in the first place. What advantage does it offer over using a single validation set?

title: Bias and k-Fold Cross-Validation
text: Consider how increasing the number of folds (k) in k-fold cross-validation might affect the model's bias. What happens to the training and validation sets as k increases?

title: Evaluating Cross-Validation Statements
text: Which of the following statements is true about cross-validation?
choices: >Cross-validation cannot be used in production, as the model is cheating by looking at validation samples.
>We use cross validation because it is less computationally intensive than regular validation.
>We use cross validation over regular validation because cross validation allows us to use the entire training data set to test the model.
Increasing k in $$k-fold$$ cross validation decreases the bias of the model.
